description: Standalone Pennsylvania childcare acquisition and verified normalization, with durable app receipts and explicit retained-input reuse.

acquiredManifestPath.description: Explicit verified immutable acquisition for offline reuse; omission selects native collection.

output_schema_contract.zip: ZIP5 and ZIP4 separate; missing ZIP preserved with explicit reason
output_schema_contract.geocode: Nullable latitude/longitude only; no business polygons

redirect_policy: Fixed native PA endpoints only with redirects rejected and credentials omitted. Explicit retained mode performs no network requests.
publisher_exclusion: Native app collection exclusively owns data/business-sources/pa-childcare-centers/runtime/publisher.lock across output roots before provider requests until child writers drain and terminal persistence completes. Unknown ownership is never stolen. Injected tests and offline retained-input reuse do not acquire this native publisher lock.
retry: No automatic source retries or job restart. Publisher deferrals fail finitely. Reuse a verified completed acquisition for downstream repair rather than downloading again.
checkpoint: Durable start precedes acquisition. Persist acquired and normalized manifest references after each child publication, even if cancellation arrives at a child commit boundary. Publish terminal receipt last without overwrite.
idempotency: UUID app job and run-scoped child outputs. Native and injected modes cannot borrow another job's child releases; retained mode explicitly pins the selected existing acquisition. No current or national pointer update.
cancellation: Cooperative 30-minute app deadline; drain child writers before terminal persistence and ownership release. Published inputs/outputs survive failure or cancellation. OS stalls and forced termination require inspection, not automatic restart.
retention_profile: Internal selected source, normalized/quarantine data and immutable app receipts. Preserve completed acquisitions and uncertain publications. No public export or automatic national integration.
